intro: The One That Got Away is a quest offered by Ephram Barbaro to track down a rogue cultist who escaped a skirmish near Naxxramas remnants. The fugitive fled beneath Shadowvale carrying an active fragment of a focusing crystal that threatens to empower or reanimate the dead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.
Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the damned thing?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...
